title: Watten
declarePhase: Declare — pick a Schlag rank and a critical (trump) suit.

trumpPanel.title: Top-trump preview
trumpPanel.rule: Once declared, the ranking runs Max (♥K) > Belli (♦K) > Spitz (♦7), then the cards of the Schlag rank, then the remaining critical-suit cards. Below are your hand's top trumps for the current choice.
trumpPanel.none: Pick a Schlag rank and critical suit to see which of your cards become top trumps. (The permanent trumps always count.)

tutorial.trickDisplay: The current trick. The three permanent top trumps are Max (K♥) > Belli (K♦) > Spitz (7♦), then all cards of the Schlag rank, then the critical suit, then plain cards.
tutorial.playerHand: Your hand. Click a card to select it, then Play. You are seat 0 (team 0); the player across from you is your partner.
tutorial.playButton: Once a card is selected, play it with this button. As lead you may Raise the stake; if raised, respond with Hold or Fold. In the Declare phase, pick a Schlag rank and critical suit and declare.
tutorial.info: Watten is a Bavarian/Austrian 4-player, 2-team trick-taker. Five cards are dealt from a 32-card pack; the dealer declares a Schlag rank and a critical (trump) suit. A team that wins at least three of the five tricks scores the stake, and the first team to 15 (configurable) wins the match.
tutorial.resetButton: Use the reset button to start a new game.
